name: start_billing_run
title: Start a billing run
description: Start a billing run for a firm. The run takes 30 to 90 seconds and advances through four phases. This call returns immediately with a handle rather than waiting. Poll the handle until the run reaches a terminal status; the final status is then available. Starting a run writes to the billing system of record.

executed_by_advisor_id.description: Advisor the run is executed for. Must be an advisor the caller may act for.

outputSchema.description: The final result, delivered on the task once it completes.
